translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Corintios

content: Mani weleged-igargi Pablo sunmaksad
Gwenadgan, Jesucristogi-akananaimaladga mani welegedsik, an bemarga sogdo, igi Bab Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-Galaciagi-bukmaladga an sogsa, ayob bemar imakmarmogodo.
Itoged-iliba gebe-iba-nagudedgi bemar mani na wis urbemar, ar igi na be mani wis onosmaladba, adi mer geb an monadapir, bemar mani wenai-gumalagar.
An bemarse modapile, ar bemar dulemar Jerusalénse-mani-sedega na be susmalad garda-nikaa an barmidoed.
Ar an-sunnad an namogo an dakele, dulemar-Jerusalénse-mani-sedmaloed anba namalodo.
Pablo Corintose-naedgi binsamaid
An Macedoniase-arbid-sorba, an bemarse nadapoed, ar Macedoniase-naed anga igar maid.
An bemar-walik undarsaar-meger megodo, sulirdi, di-wied-nii-berguedse an bemar-abargi mego an insado. Geb a-sorba bemar an-barmidoed, an nabiedba.
Ar emigindi unnila sikwas an bemar-dakbisurdo, wis undarsaar bemar-abargi an gudi-sabied, ar Bab Dummad degi-abeger.
Ar emigindi Pentecostés-Ibagan-naguedse Efesogi an mai-guoed.
Ar ade an daked bela-bela nabir Bab-Jesús-igargi an sunmako an daked, degi-inigwele, bukidar Bab-Jesús-igar-istar-dakmalad nikbalid.
Bemarse Timoteo modapile, nue akwemalo, adi weligwar bemar-abargi gudiguegar, ar Bab-Dummadga-arbadimogad-duled, igi an arbadimogadyob.
Degisoggu, mer Timoteo ibgwensur be dakmalo. Anse nue bogidikidgi barmidaged be imakmalo, ar ade gwenadgan-baiganmala anmar Timoteo-edarbedii-gumaloed.
Gwenad-Apolosdi, yapa emiskwadi bemarse nae-gusad, ar an egi wilenaigusando, gwenadgan-baiganmala bemarse ataknaegar. Apolos bemarse ataknadapo an insado, nabir ega igargan argader.
Pablo we-gardagi napi gwenadganga ibmar sogsad
¡Nue atakmar, mer gabmar, salakarmar, Bab-Jesúsgi-bensulidgi! Dobsuli na be nanamar, gannargwaa na be imakmar.
Bela bemar ibmar-imakedi, sabedgi be imakmar.
Gwenadgan, bemar wisid, Estéfanas-negginmalad-inse Acayagi Bab-Jesús-abingasad, emigindi amar Jesucristogi-akananaimalad-bendakdimalad.
Degisoggu, an be-abemarsundo, bemar dulemar-weyob-damalad-urbalii gudigued, degine, dulemar-gadi-arbamalad, degi, dulemar-Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-gadi-bendakmalad-urbalii bemar gudigumarsundo.
An yeer itodo, Estéfanas, Fortunato, degine, Acaico anse nonimargu, ar ade amar bemar-nuggi an-bendaknonimalad.
A-dulemar burbar nue an-ogannononimalad, degine, burbar bemar-ogannosmarmogad. Dulemar-degi-damalad bemar a-dulemar mag-dake nanae-wilubmalad.

Asia-yargi Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad, bemar nued sogeye, bemarga sogsimalad. Aquila, Priscila-ebo, degi, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-e-neggi-danar-ambikunoni-damalad, Bab-Jesús-nuggi, bemar nued sogeye, bemarse gorsimogad.
Gwenadgan bela bemarse gorsimalad, bemarde nued sogeye. Na be muchub-muchub bela angaagwale na be nued sogeye, na ga be sogmar.
Ani Pablo, an-argan-sunnadgi we an bemarga narmakdo, bemar nued sogeye.
Ar dule-gwensak Dummad-Jesucristo-sabsulile, a-dule bato ukabsaleged nabirid. ¡Anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo, be dage!
Anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo bitigi bemargi nued binsamalana-gadin.
An Cristo-Jesúsgi bemar-sabed, bela bemarba gudiguena-gadin. Be itomargua.
